data.name: Gräuel: Supporter Edition
data.detailed_description:
Dive into the world of Gräuel with even more style thanks to the Supporter Edition!

This DLC will be expanded with future game updates.
data.about_the_game:
Dive into the world of Gräuel with even more style thanks to the Supporter Edition!

This DLC will be expanded with future game updates.
data.short_description: Customize your character in Gräuel with the Supporter Edition! Enjoy recolored versions of all in-game cosmetics and exclusive outfits inspired by the game’s monsters. Plus, this DLC will expand with each update, offering even more content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core i5 (Quad Core or better) / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660TI 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 - 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7 (6 Core or better) / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
